```{r setup}
library(fastMILC)
library(data.table)
```

## Scope

`fastMILC` re-implements the continuous-time microsimulation lung-cancer model
MILC (Chrysanthopoulou, 2014). The archival package draws each person's
history with scalar inverse-CDF and root-finding steps. `fastMILC` draws each
component for the whole population at once with the `nhppp` samplers:

| Component | Model | Sampler |
|---|---|---|
| Death from other causes | step rates from the archival CIF tables | `nhppp::vdraw_sc_step()` |
| Onset of the first malignant cell | two-stage clonal expansion, piecewise over the smoking history | `nhppp::vdraw_cumulative_intensity()` + vectorized Newton inverse |
| Progression and stage | Gompertz growth, truncated log-normal volume thresholds | inverse CDF + row-wise rejection |
| Death from lung cancer | step rates from the archival CIF tables | `nhppp::vdraw_sc_step()` |

## Simulating a population

The canonical recipe is `synthetic_nlst_recipe`, synthetic NLST-like data on
26,730 current and former smokers who enter the study on 2002-06-30. The
simulation starts at entry; only people alive and without a diagnosed lung
cancer at entry enter it.

```{r simulate}
options(milc.globalRNG.seed = rep(20021115, 6))
pop <- Population$new(target_population_size = 1000)$getPopulation()
nrow(pop)
```

Lung-cancer diagnoses during follow-up, by smoking status at entry:

```{r incidence}
pop[, .(
  n = .N,
  diagnosed = mean(!is.na(age_at_diagnosis)),
  died_of_lung_cancer = mean(cause_of_death == "lung_cancer", na.rm = TRUE)
), by = smoking_status_at_spawn_age]
```

Stage at diagnosis:

```{r stage}
pop[!is.na(stage_at_diagnosis), .N, by = stage_at_diagnosis][, share := N / sum(N)][]
```

## Using a generator directly

Each component is a plain vectorized function. For example, ages at death
from other causes for three 60-year-old men:

```{r generator}
generate_death_other(
  age_entry = c(60, 60, 60),
  sex = rep("male", 3),
  smoking_status = c("never", "former", "current"),
  intensity = c(0, 20, 20)
)
```

The model mathematics and every difference from the archival code are
documented in `model_description/model.tex` in the source repository.
